name: binding_43dbm_6vpm
comment: Medium binding regime: macro 20W (43 dBm) on 8x8 panel against post-2014 Brussels / Italy attention level (6 V/m). Oracle Newton converges ~60% of slots, proposed (with Cauchy on tier-C envelopes) hits min-absorption fallback - which is exactly the gap the paper's pose-info-gain story wants to show.
